description: This file defines an enum 'CaptureRateLimits' that provides utility functions to clamp duration in milliseconds and frames per second (FPS) within specified ranges.

methods.name: clampDurationMs
methods.description: Clamps the input duration in milliseconds to be within minMs and maxMs, defaulting to defaultMs if nil.

methods.name: clampFps
methods.description: Clamps the input FPS to be within minFps and maxFps, defaulting to defaultFps if nil and ensuring the value is finite.
